requirements.why: 32% of problems share NO specific atom with their correct solution, so set-containment retrieval returns 0 by construction. No re-weighting/IDF/fusion can exceed this floor.
requirements.mathematical_core: containment(T,S) = |T∩S|/|T| = 0 when T∩S=∅. Exceeding it requires COMPOSING with a map f: text→R^d and a metric where related(paraphrase) > unrelated, i.e. a learned semantic embedding, not a bigger atom set.

requirements.why: Among retrievable pairs, top-1 is only 64%; ranking leaves correctness on the table.
requirements.mathematical_core: Ranking is a monotone function of the score; improving it means learning a score that is monotone in true relevance (a supervised ranking objective), not hand-set weights.

requirements.why: Retrieval can only return mechanisms present in the corpus; measured 0-overlap retrievals for cache-single-flight and invoice-dedup show coverage limits, independent of matching quality.
requirements.mathematical_core: recall <= 1 - P(correct mechanism absent from corpus). No matcher fixes an absent target.

requirements.why: Improvements must be proven, not assumed: the campaign found 10+ real bugs in surfaces that 'looked healthy'.
requirements.mathematical_core: adopt a change only if it improves a held-out metric beyond its noise floor (paired test), else reject.
